Kate Morales: Quick one  candidate (Hao Chen) flagged a visa interview delay; embassy moved his slot so he can't travel in time. He asked if we can do the first-day loop remotely and then in-person the next day at a nearby coworking hub. Need logistics.
Rohan Singh: We can split the loop. I'll host remote panels Mon AM and do on-site Tue. Which coworking hub? Do we have a company partner nearby?
People Ops (Lia): We have a partner space (EastSide Hub) that allows day passes and lockers. Reception won't be there so we need a packet and pickup instructions. Also Hao asked for a visa support letter stating interview dates and company contact  Visa Team can draft?
Visa Team: We can draft the invitation/support letter. Need full name, passport number, intended travel dates, and the address where he'll be interviewing. Please DM details.
Kate Morales: Sending DM with passport and tentative dates. Also note he requested a halal meal and a quiet desk with a standing option for Tue.
IT Desk: Loaner check (quick):
``` 
loaners.get_available(date="2024-11-05 to 2024-11-06", os="mac") => [MAC-21, MAC-30]
```
IT Desk: MAC-21 available; we can image and ship to EastSide Hub for pickup or leave it locked in a courier box at reception. Shipping to hub requires partner approval; simpler to stage at Reception with a pickup code.
People Ops (Lia): EastSide Hub partner requires 24h notice for equipment drop-offs. Reception Bot  can reception hold the device with a pickup code in the packet?
Reception Bot: Yes  we can hold loaner and provide a one-time pickup code. Please include "Hold for Hao Chen" on the tag and provide expected pickup window.
Travel Admin: If he needs an overnight after the in-person day we can book a nearby hotel. Also note we cover local coworking fees for interviews. I'll reserve EastSide day-pass pending confirmation.
Kate Morales: Great. One more security item: Hao needs temporary building badge and access to the secure kiosk for background ID check on arrival. Can Security pre-create a one-time kiosk QR that he can show at the hub?
Visa Team: Drafted the visa letter and emailed Lia for signature.
IT Desk: Imaging MAC-21 now and setting local user; will disable external networking for any demo server. ETA stage at Reception by 08:30 Tue. Pickup code: 4792 (will redact in candidate email).
People Ops (Lia): I've updated the calendar: Mon remote panels (links included), Tue in-person at EastSide Hub with loaner pickup at Reception (code in email), halal boxed lunch, standing desk request, and background kiosk QR. Sent candidate confirmation with visa letter attached.
Rohan Singh: Thanks  I'll host remote and then meet him Tue at reception at 09:15 to escort to the hub. Ping here if Visa Team needs anything else.
Reception Bot: Packet printed and loaner staged for Tue. Kiosk QR created and attached to packet. All set. :white_check_mark:
